### 🎁 Expected Outcome by the EU

::: {.callout-important icon=true}
### Expected Outcomes: {{< meta title >}} 
- 📰 **Reinforced Digital Transformation:** Accelerate the technological evolution of the news media industry by generating resilient, inclusive business models that anchor democratic stability.
- 🗳️ **Empowered Citizenship:** Equip citizens—particularly those facing systemic disadvantages—with tools to access verified info, mitigating algorithmic fragmentation and promoting a fair democracy.
- 🎯 **Emerging Creator Accountability:** Foster a trustworthy information ecosystem by actively engaging online content producers and influencers to increase reliance on verified journalistic principles.
:::

### 🏗️ Scope Summary

::: {.callout-warning icon=true}
### Scope: {{< meta title >}} 

Applicants are invited to collaborate directly with news media organizations from inception to build workable prototypes, industrial applications, and interoperable standard frameworks across two primary action clusters:

#### 🤖 Technological & Algorithmic Intervention
- **Journalistic Content Recognition:** Design industry-led crawlers, browser plugins, common taxonomies, and metadata standards to categorize and prioritize content abiding by professional principles.
- **AI-Driven Monetization Services:** Deploy AI models to build revenue-generating architectures, including dynamic paywalls, proprietary ad-tech metadata generators, search aggregators, and copyright revenue trackers.
- **Trust-Oriented Recommender Systems:** Develop transparent recommender engines that mitigate "infotainment" bias, presenting plural viewpoints and ranking quality information over unverified opinions.

#### 🧠 Behavioural & Systemic Interventions
- **Behavioral Data Science:** Leverage behavioral interventions (nudges, gamification, educational indicators) to counter misinformation, analyzing how reader habits shape trust between human-curated and AI-driven news delivery.
- **Social Media Creator Integration:** Advocate for transparency and source-disclosure mechanisms among online creators, federating media segments along a joint innovation agenda.

🔗 **Infrastructure Requirements:** Where applicable, consortia should leverage data and services through European Research Infrastructures federated under the `European Open Science Cloud (EOSC)` and relevant institutional Data Spaces.
:::

## 🛣️ Strategic Alignment

This Innovation Action (IA) centers on near-market, technical adaptation to keep journalism economically viable in AI-intermediated information spaces. By building proprietary ad-tech architectures and structured metadata systems, the call aims to shift news media away from reactive, click-driven models toward robust, sovereign distribution platforms.

Our work bridges technical metadata standards with structural media governance to prevent systemic data fragmentation across digital public squares.

::: {.callout-tip icon=true}
### SCVCS' Technical Value Proposition
We provide the underlying governance, RegTech capabilities, and architectural frameworks necessary to anchor an **AI Environmental/Reputation Governance Harness**.

This software platform layer (bridging **RegTech** and **FinTech**) provides the exact tracking infrastructure required by this call's monetization and auditing mandates. By engineering transparent, user-centric metadata frameworks and ad-tech tracking protocols, our architecture verifies compliance with professional standards, ensures trust indicators are hardcoded into data storage, and provides advertisers with brand-safety feedback without creating algorithmic silos.
:::

---

## 🤝 SCVCS' Core Areas of Collaboration

We are utilizing our research frameworks to establish structural bridges with partners targeting the following call mandates:

1. 🔏 **Metadata Standards & Data Sovereignty:** Implementing structured metadata registries and crawler taxonomies. We apply the [International Data Spaces](https://internationaldataspaces.org/) framework to ensure that newsroom content, when accessed by large AI aggregators, maintains trace ownership and captures appropriate copyright revenues while preserving data sovereignty.

2. 🌊 **Socio-Technical Trust Cybernetics:** Applying systemic models to analyze public trust dynamics across human-curated and AI-driven delivery networks. This converts behavioral science theories into operational, transparent metrics within algorithmic recommender engines to foster inclusive democratic spaces.

3. 🏫 **Co-Creation Testing Environments:** Partnering with regional media segments, tech platforms, and information science networks to build "Living Lab" style environments. These spaces allow journalists, community groups, and ad-tech companies to collaboratively iterate and test workable prototypes under real-world economic pressure.

::: {.callout-note icon=true}
### 👷 Consortium Engagement

We are actively seeking to connect with:

- 🇪🇺 **EU-Based Consortium Leads:** Media houses, academic research institutions, or ad-tech pioneers looking to integrate clear socio-technical engineering, systemic governance metrics, or RegTech monetization auditing into their Part B proposal layout.
- 📰 **Independent Media Ecosystem Actors:** Sectoral media groups, public broadcasters, or independent creator networks seeking to anchor multi-perspective news aggregators or dynamic paywall prototypes.
:::
